stories.title: Upwork CEO Hayden Brown sells $4.26 million in company stock
stories.summary: Upwork CEO Hayden Brown sold $4.26 million in company stock, according to a regulatory filing reported by Investing.com. The filing did not state a reason for the sale.
stories.whyItMatters: Investors track insider sales for signs of how executives view their own company's stock.
whatToWatch: Future filings showing further insider sales or purchases at Upwork
Upwork's next earnings report for context
questions: Was the sale part of a pre-set trading plan?
How large is Brown's remaining stake in Upwork?

stories.title: Senti Biosciences Holdings appoints KNAV CPA as new auditor, replaces KPMG
stories.summary: Senti Biosciences Holdings appointed KNAV CPA as its new auditor, replacing KPMG, according to a regulatory filing reported by Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: An auditor change can signal shifts in a company's financial oversight and sometimes precedes other disclosures.
whatToWatch: Senti Biosciences' next financial filings under the new auditor
Any stated reason for the KPMG departure
questions: Why did Senti Biosciences switch auditors?
Did KPMG resign or was it dismissed?

stories.title: Private equity firm GTCR explores takeover of Global Payments
stories.summary: Private equity firm GTCR is exploring a potential takeover of payments company Global Payments, Investing.com reported. Terms and timing of any possible deal were not disclosed.
stories.whyItMatters: A buyout of Global Payments would rank among the largest payments-sector deals and could reshape competition among processors.
whatToWatch: Confirmation or denial of talks from GTCR or Global Payments
Any formal bid, price, or deal terms
Global Payments' stock reaction to the report
questions: Could other bidders emerge for Global Payments?

stories.title: Energy Transfer completes $2.7 billion senior notes offering

stories.title: Bitcoin heads for longest weekly losing streak since May 2022 amid AI stock rout
stories.summary: Bitcoin is on track for its longest weekly losing streak since May 2022, Investing.com reported. The decline runs alongside a broader selloff in AI-related stocks.
stories.whyItMatters: A prolonged bitcoin slide alongside an AI stock rout points to wider risk-off sentiment across speculative assets.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin's losing streak extends into another week
Whether the AI stock selloff stabilizes or deepens
questions: What is driving the AI stock rout?
Are investors rotating out of risk assets broadly, or just crypto and AI names?
